newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-CSKA SUFFER UPSET DEFEAT IN RUSSIAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CSKA SUFFER UPSET DEFEAT IN RUSSIAN CUP.

text.p: Premier league CSKA Moscow suffered a surprise home defeat at the hands of first division Zarya in the third round of the Russian Cup on Wednesday.
Zarya, third from bottom, battled the Army team to a scoreless draw after extra time, then went through to the quarter-final 8-7 on penalties.
Last year's runners-up, Alania Vladikavkaz, crashed 1-0 to unheralded Krylya Sovietov in Samara. Garnik Avalyan scored a 50th minute winner.
Another premier division side, Zenit of St. Petersburg, were held 0-0 after extra time at home to first division Lokomotiv Chita, but won 4-3 on penalties.

Torpedo Moscow saved face for the bigger clubs when they crushed Lada Togliatti 6-1 in Moscow. Having led 1-0 at halftime, the Muscovites went on a second half spree, including scoring three times in the last 12 minutes.

Zarya won the right to host yet another Moscow side, Dynamo, in the quarter-finals on May 6, while Zenit take on defending champions Spartak Moscow in St. Petersburg. Krylya Sovietov host Rotor Volgograd and Torpedo play Lokomotiv in a Moscow derby.
